IHG One Rewards is out with a new promotion to earn 3x points on Voco stays through the end of the year, starting on your second stay.

Plus, there are still ongoing offers that can yield up to 3x points on stays through the end of the year and bonus points at Ruby Hotels.

Let’s take a look at these offers to see how they can make your next IHG stay more rewarding.

Advertisement

3x Points on Voco Stays

IHG One Rewards members can earn 3x points on stays at IHG’s Voco properties from October 6 to December 6, 2026. This offer may be targeted, and it turns the normal 10 points per $1 spent into 30 points. You can check your eligibility by trying to register for this offer here

Earn up to 3X Points On Your Second Stay

Guests can earn 2x points on their second stay, and 3x points if they book via the IHG One Rewards app (iOS, Android).

This offer is valid for stays between October 1 and December 31, 2026, and registration is required.

Guests can earn unlimited bonus points during the promotion period, after their second stay.

Advertisement

Earn Bonus Points at Ruby Hotels

Travelers can earn 10,000 bonus points for every 2 nights they spend at Ruby properties between July 24 and October 31, 2026. There’s no limit to how many points you can earn with this offer.

Ruby is a limited-service brand with properties across Europe, and guests must register for this offer by October 21, 2026.

Hot Tip:

Learn more about how to earn and redeem IHG One Rewards points in our detailed guides.

Is It Worth It?

We value IHG points at 0.5 cents each, so 4,000 points are worth $20, while 10,000 points are worth $50, and 2,000 points are worth $10.

These earnings sound nice, but are you paying more to unlock them? Consider that as you compare IHG’s hotel rates against what other hotels are charging at your intended destination. If IHG is charging more, do some quick math to see if you’re spending more to earn these points than what the points are worth in the end.

If you’re already planning stays with IHG in the next few months or find a great deal on a hotel, you should definitely take advantage of these promotions. Just don’t go out of your way or spend more to earn the points.

Final Thoughts

IHG has a new promotion that lets members earn 3x points at Voco properties through December 6. That’s on top of offers for Ruby Hotels stays and up to 3x points if you book stays in the mobile app.

These offers require registration before you can start earning points.
